# Chicago New-Patient Dentist Booking Prep

A good booking request should be short, specific, and clear about your timing, symptoms, and payment needs. Since you do not have insurance, it helps to ask about self-pay pricing before you confirm a visit.

## What to Have Ready for the Appointment Request

- Full name, date of birth, and preferred phone/email
- Chicago neighborhood or ZIP code you want to be seen in
- New-patient status and brief symptom note: mild tooth sensitivity
- Preferred appointment window: 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-10, between 09:00 AM and 03:00 PM local time
- Whether you prefer a general dentist or are open to a first available provider
- Any dental history that may matter:
  - Last cleaning/exam date
  - Known allergies
  - Current medications
  - Recent dental work
  - Pregnancy status, if relevant
- Payment details:
  - Self-pay / no insurance
  - Card type you can use
  - Whether you want an estimate before booking
- Questions you want answered before confirming:
  - New-patient exam cost
  - X-ray cost
  - Whether payment plans are available

## Appointment Request Message You Can Send

Hello, I’m looking to schedule a new-patient dental appointment in Chicago between July 6 and July 10, 2026, ideally between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM.

I have mild tooth sensitivity and do not have dental insurance. Could you please let me know your earliest available appointment times, your self-pay pricing for a new-patient exam, whether X-rays are included or billed separately, and whether you offer payment plans?

Thank you.

## Pricing Questions to Compare Before You Book

| Topic | What to Ask | Why It Matters |
|---|---|---|
| New-patient exam | “What is the self-pay price for a first visit?” | Confirms the base visit cost before you go |
| X-rays | “Are X-rays included, and if not, what do they cost?” | Sensitivity often leads to diagnostic imaging |
| Payment plans | “Do you offer payment plans, membership plans, or financing?” | Helps if treatment is needed beyond the exam |
| Extra fees | “Are there fees for records, consultation, or emergency add-ons?” | Avoids surprise charges |
| Follow-up treatment | “If I need a filling or treatment, can I get a written estimate first?” | Lets you compare options before agreeing |
| Discounts | “Do you have self-pay discounts or new-patient specials?” | May reduce out-of-pocket cost |

## Quick Actions
